source: I05-A retained development data; not reused as remediation admission data
failed_old_rule: each Proper run compared with the three-seed ESTA median
diagnosis: The sole failure was caused by comparing seed 6301 with the lower cross-seed ESTA median. Proper was better than ESTA for that same seed. Logs showed no fault, saturation, state sharing, mapping error, or calibration drift. This does not retroactively pass I05-A; it motivates a new paired-seed admission rule.
parameter_decision: No gain or g change before R-A. Revalidate the unchanged controller with fresh paired seeds.
